name: Blackened Skull
summary: A blackened skull is the charred cranial remnant of a Darkeye Bonecaster animating in the Agamand Mills. Deathguard Dillinger in Brill demands these grisly trophies as proof of thinning the mindless Scourge forces threatening Tirisfal Glades.

sections.title: Trophy of the Bonecasters
sections.body: Charred and saturated with necromantic energies, these skulls are salvaged from the Darkeye Bonecasters haunting the Agamand Mills. These skeletal spellcasters direct necromantic malice against the living and the Forsaken alike, attempting to entrench a forward base for the Lich King's armies in northern Tirisfal. Presenting their ruined skulls to Deathguard Dillinger serves as tangible evidence that the Scourge's mystical vanguard is being crushed.

faq.q: Where do blackened skulls come from?
faq.answer: They are collected from the remains of Darkeye Bonecasters, the skeletal spellcasters prowling the fields and structures around the Agamand Mills in northern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why does Deathguard Dillinger want blackened skulls?
faq.answer: Deathguard Dillinger tasks Forsaken defenders with gathering blackened skulls and notched ribs as proof of active combat against the Scourge. The Forsaken cannot permit the Lich King's mindless minions to establish a foothold so close to Brill and the Undercity.
The skulls are described as blackened, but the source does not explain what caused the discoloration. They are collected from Darkeye Bonecasters at Agamand Mills.

faq.q: What is the Scourge doing at Agamand Mills?
aliases: why are scourge at the mills
faq.answer: The Scourge are attempting to fortify the abandoned Agamand Mills as a forward staging ground, using it to launch deeper attacks and raids across Tirisfal Glades.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, bringing down Darkeye Bonecasters is a matter of pure survival, preventing their former master from establishing a staging ground on their doorstep.
The skulls are physical remains of the Darkeye Bonecasters, the skeletal spellcasters targeted at Agamand Mills.
